messages:
olivia: dropping RN draft + internal announce plan for v2.5 rollout. need quick copycheck, a pin owner, and someone to watch rollback gates. plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• What: v2.5-quant-lite — updated quant kernels, ~18% average token throughput uplift on mid-long contexts
• Why: reduce unit cost and stabilize streaming for long prompts
• Fixes: KV cache warmup improvement, mitigation for rare streaming stalls on 64k contexts
• Compatibility: Dedicated customers will fallback to pinned v2.4 if GPU pool is constrained

olivia: rollout sketch: canary 2% -> 15% after 12m -> 50% after 50m -> 100% after 120m. rollback gates: error >2.5x baseline for 4m OR p95 latency >650ms for 10m. will enable debug logs for canary for first 20m.

rachel: quick copy nit — change "fallback to pinned v2.4" -> "automatic fallback to v2.4 for Dedicated when capacity limited". Also add one-line for customer-facing note about brief warmup.

olivia: updated RN and customer line: "Rolling update to reduce token cost; brief warmup expected."

matt: i can own the model pin & run. proposed model id: model-redwood/v2.5-q1 pinned to inference-v2.5 stack.

jordan: i'll take rollback watch and the final GO/NO-GO. i'll wire alerts and a short heartbeat. ping me at promote->15%.

leo: docs will post internal snippet in #internal-release at T-10. suggested blurb: "Heads up: v2.5 rollout at 18:00 UTC — improves throughput and cache warmup. Ops monitoring; status updates to follow."

matt: scheduling deploy at 2025-08-01T18:00:00Z. deploy-bot params below.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @matt. job id: db-2051234567. params:
```
deploy-bot run db-2051234567 --stage canary --percent 2 --wait 720 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-2051234567 --percent 15 --wait 1200 --dns-hold 300
deploy-bot promote db-2051234567 --percent 50 --wait 4200 --fallback-delay 600
deploy-bot promote db-2051234567 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-2051234567 --reason "rollback gate triggered"
```

matt: adding --dns-hold 300 and --fallback-delay 600 as requested. will run a dry-run in staging at T-30.

jordan: please add --sample-rate 1s for canary metrics. i'll reduce alert thresholds for first 25m and prepare the rollback playbook link: https://go/release/runbook/v2.5.

rachel: i'll be on standby for copy edits and will post the internal snippet at T-10. also prepping release notes page and changelog entry.

olivia: final checklist: RN updated, customer snippet set, model pin model-redwood/v2.5-q1, deploy job scheduled and queued, rollback watch assigned to jordan, metrics sample rate set, DNS hold and fallback-delay flags added. go/no-go at 17:40 UTC.

matt: will confirm at 17:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-2051234567 created and moved to queued state by @matt.
